TotalAcres.definition: Total number of acres available for processing hay

NumMachines.definition: Number of different machine types available for processing hay

MethaneLimit.definition: Maximum allowable amount of methane gas production

HayProcessedPerAcre.definition: Amount of hay processed per acre by each machine type

MethaneProducedPerAcre.definition: Amount of methane gas produced per acre by each machine type

FuelRequiredPerAcre.definition: Amount of fuel required per acre by each machine type
